title: Fact-preserving patch rollback factorial
summary: The frozen 16-task control calibration completed 16 known model calls, zero unknowns: all initial patches passed public and private tests. limitations: Calibration ceiling, not evidence for or against rollback. Four authored families. Visible patch deletion with workspace restoration held constant; private reasoning is not manipulated. Model revision and actual subscription debit are unavailable.

summary: The 16-task composite calibration completed 22 known calls with no unknowns or capacity stops. limitations: Control-only task development, no factorial effect evidence. The three observed errors concern dependency resolution despite different leading-family labels. All task facts are preserved; the actual failed diffs contain useful partial work as well as defects. Source and failed gate preserved.

title: Exploratory patch deletion and lesson factorial
summary: The fixed 256-task exploratory cohort completed all 1280 dispositions in two phases: 417 admissions, 408 received, nine preserved unknowns. Twenty-eight eligible substantial failed patches; known terminal correctness K0=27/27 (+1 missing), R0=27/27 (+1 missing), KL=28/28, RL=27/28. The sole failed repair reintroduced refund handling already fixed in its initial patch. Offline checkpoint comparison identifies 158 newly passing component instances on the 24 saved tests; matched first-repair regressions are K0/R0=0/6 and KL/RL=0/7.
limitations: Unplanned follow-up after a failed control-only gate. An internal quota-check RPC interrupted phase zero; a frozen amendment completed only unsent original work. The inherited global stop permanently fails the isolated-content interpretation gate. Seven unknown initial outcomes and two missing repair outcomes remain missing. Related authored tasks, categorical lessons, three-attempt ceiling; no general equivalence or private-reasoning claim.
